messages:
Maya (product): Quick check-in: we need a discovery endpoint that plays nicely with SDKs and customer eval pipelines. Main asks: fine-grained streaming descriptors, function-calling contract, and token accounting rules.
Jon (eng-runtime): Suggest `/v1/models/:id/discover` returning `features`, `limits`, `streaming_details`, `tooling` (link) and `etag`. Keep booleans explicit to avoid parsing ambiguity.
Lina (eng-ml): Include `embedding_dim` for embed models and `deterministic: true|false`. Also add `recommended_batch_size` so SDKs can pick defaults.
Sam (solutions): Sales asks: include `supports_json_schema`, `streaming_protocols` and `max_token_window`. Also `tooling_visibility` so customers know if tool manifests require approval.
ci-bot: Buildkite: discovery-service tests passed for 4 commits.
Maya (product): Launch checklist suggestion: 1) API spec + curl example, 2) SDKs updated to read `etag` and cache appropriately, 3) infra signing TTL 15min, 4) two customer integrations validated, 5) docs + migration notes for older SDKs.
Jon (eng-runtime): For streaming we should specify `mode`: `sse|ws|chunked` and `ordering_guarantee` (none|per-request). Also `sse_retry_ms`.
Lina (eng-ml): For function calling include `max_args_size` and `preferred_schema_format` (json_schema|openapi). Mark models with `strict_schema: true` for those that validate output.
Sam (solutions): Add a `fallback_model_id` and `fallback_reason` field so clients can auto-fall back. This reduces surprise behavior.
Maya (product): Action items: Jon prototype JSON by tomorrow, Lina to extend onboarding to populate numeric fields, Sam to collect customer fallbacks we should document. CI will run the golden prompt regression suite.
